Limiting_Cases_Behavior: H_GL -> 0 => q = 0; C_bed -> inf => q -> 0; n=3, m=1/3 => prefactor exponent = 0.75, H exponent = 4.75

Mathematical_Definition: Normalized parameter indicating dynamic health/confinement of downstream ice shelf
Convention_and_Admissible_Bounds: theta_buttress in [0.0, 1.0]. Standard convention: 0.0 = UNBUTTRESSED (collapsed/absent shelf), 1.0 = FULL / INTACT NATURAL SHELF
Limiting_Cases_Behavior: theta = 0.0 => open ocean calving, maximum unbuttressed discharge; theta = 1.0 => fully buttressed intact natural steady-state shelf

Mathematical_Definition: Fraction of longitudinal tensile stress absorbed by fjord walls and pinning points in fully buttressed state
Convention_and_Admissible_Bounds: omega_b in [0.40, 0.85] (Category D/E: Fürst et al. 2016; Reese et al. 2018). Strict upper bound omega_b < 1.0
Limiting_Cases_Behavior: omega_b = 0.0 => wide open embayment (zero back-stress capacity); omega_b -> 1.0 => complete theoretical confinement

Mathematical_Definition: Exponent relating back-stress reduction to grounding-line discharge scaling (Gudmundsson 2013; Pegler 2018)
Convention_and_Admissible_Bounds: mu in [1.0, 3.0]; theoretical value for n=3, m=1/3 is mu = (m+n+3)/((m+1)*n) = 4.75 / 3 = 1.583 (or gamma = 2.25 for basal stress coupling)
Limiting_Cases_Behavior: mu = 1.0 => linear stress reduction; mu > 1.0 => progressive non-linear discharge suppression

Convention_and_Admissible_Bounds: R_buttress in [(1 - omega_b)^mu, 1.0]. For omega_b=0.75, mu=2.0: range is [0.0625, 1.0000]
Limiting_Cases_Behavior: theta=0 => R=1.0 (unbuttressed); theta=1 => R=(1 - omega_b)^mu > 0 (intact shelf maintains finite positive flux, matching 3x-8x collapse speedups)

Mathematical_Definition: Dimensionless calibration prefactor scaling 1D analytical flux to 2D/3D transition dynamics
Convention_and_Admissible_Bounds: C_schoof in [0.30, 1.50]; reference benchmark value = 0.61 (MISMIP Pattyn et al. 2012)
Limiting_Cases_Behavior: C_schoof = 1.0 => uncorrected 1D asymptotic formula; C_schoof = 0.61 => standard MISMIP full-Stokes match

Mathematical_Definition: Q_GL = C_schoof * W_GL * [ 1 - omega_b * theta_buttress ]^mu * q_unbutt(H_GL)
Convention_and_Admissible_Bounds: Valid for H_GL > 0 m and W_GL > 0 m. Enforce Q_GL = 0 for H_GL <= 0 m identically.
Limiting_Cases_Behavior: Guarantees strictly positive finite flux for all physical states; completely avoids unphysical zero-flux lockup at theta=1
